channel.title: Catholic Canada
channel.desc: Host Francis Denis explores the deep roots of Catholicism in Western Canada ? from the early missionaries to the vibrant faith communities that flourish today. In Vancouver, he visits the Seminary of Christ the King, where priestly formation is united with Benedictine monastic life. The journey also leads to Bruno, Saskatchewan, where artist Tianna Williams reveals how her sacred art transforms tradition and devotion into living beauty. (30 minutes).
